source: MS-ILLM local categorical discriminator; fixed GVC-RT/B1
D_loss: .5*mean(CE(D(GT,c), y+1))+.5*mean(CE(D(rec.detach,c),0)); whole-step frames averaged before one optimizer.step
B_rms: one detached sqrt(mean(c.float()**2)) over C/H/W per frame; divisor max(r,1e-6)
C_zero: zero condition during BOTH training and validation; same conditional architecture; adapter biases allowed

validation: TINY all6 saved points:8 fit pairs +20 unseen windows; MAIN all5 saved points:40 seen+20 unseen windows; no validation-driven selection
unseen: no source-frame overlap with shared-plan windows; does not assert absent historical exposure
predictive_frequency_reference: training labels only; content Laplace alpha=1; balanced p_fake=.5; validation frequencies descriptive only
